blocks.ar:
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
الحروف المشبهة بالفعل
blocks.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. The particles resembling the verb
The particles resembling the verb

blocks.caption: الحروف المشبهة بالفعل
blocks.caption_en: The six particles and their meanings

blocks.en: The above (حروف) particles are called: {{term|الحروف المشبهة بالفعل}} because they have certain characteristics which are exclusive to verbs. Some of those characteristics are:
items: They govern 2 parts of a sentence, one of which they make {{ruling|منصوب}} and the other, they make {{ruling|مرفوع}}.
Their form consists of {{ruling|3 or more letters}}.
They contain meanings which are often found in verbs.
They can have a {{term|ضمير منصوب متصل}} attach to them.
They can also have a {{term|نون الوقاية}} attach to them.
They all end with a {{ruling|فتحة}} resembling الفعل الماضي.

blocks.ar: جملة إسمية / مسند إليه / مسند / خبر
blocks.en: They ONLY enter upon a ({{condition|جملة إسمية}}) sentence (unless deactivated) and make the "مسند إليه" {{ruling|منصوب}} and the "مسند" {{ruling|مرفوع}} if the خبر {{condition|is a noun}}.

Since they enter a (جملة إسمية) sentence, ALL the rules relating to the construction of a (جملة إسمية) sentence such as the {{term|رابط}} rule, the correlation of N/G etc will {{ruling|remain active}}.
The مسند إليه is then termed as "{{term|The Ism of Inna/Anna...}}" ...إسمُ إنَّ/أَنَّ and the مسند as "{{term|The Khabar of Inna/Anna...}}" ...خبرُ إنَّ/أَنَّ.

After they enter the (جملة إسمية) sentence, the construction remains a (جملة إسمية) sentence {{condition|except with Anna أَنَّ}}. The (جملة إسمية) sentence is {{ruling|demoted to a مفرد}} when Anna أَنَّ enters the (جملة إسمية) sentence.
Indeed
Inna, rule 1
items: a) It ONLY enters a ({{condition|جملة إسمية}}) sentence.
b) After it enters the (جملة إسمية) sentence, the construction will remain a ({{ruling|جملة}}) sentence.
c) It gives {{ruling|emphasis}} to the meaning from the perspective of the first person.
d) It will make the "مسند إليه" {{ruling|منصوب}} and it will make the "مسند" {{ruling|مرفوع}} if the مسند {{condition|is a noun}}.

blocks.ar:
إِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَاحِدٌ
الحرف المشبهة بالفعل: إنَّ
جملة إسمية: اللّٰهُ وَاحِدٌ
إنَّ + جملة = جملة
blocks.en: Indeed Allah is One. Inna + sentence = sentence
Inna, rule 2
items: a) However, if it's خبر {{condition|is a جملة}}, whether فعلية or إسمية, there will {{ruling|not be any visible effect}} of the الحرف المشبهة بالفعل.
b) The effect will only be {{ruling|assumed}}.

blocks.ar:
إِنَّ اللّٰهَ خَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
الحرف المشبهة بالفعل: إنَّ
جملة إسمية: اللّٰهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
جملة فعلية: خَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
إنَّ + جملة = جملة
blocks.en: Indeed Allah created everything. Inna + sentence = sentence
Inna, rule 3
items: a) However, if the مسند {{condition|is a جملة}}, whether فعلية or إسمية, there will {{ruling|not be any visible effect}} of the الحرف المشبهة بالفعل.
b) The effect will only be {{ruling|assumed}}.

blocks.ar:
إِنَّ اللّٰهَ ذَاتُهُ وَاحِدٌ
الحرف المشبهة بالفعل: إنَّ
جملة إسمية: اللّٰهُ ذَاتُهُ وَاحِدٌ
جملة إسمية: ذَاتُهُ وَاحِدٌ
إنَّ + جملة = جملة
blocks.en: Indeed Allah, His essence is One. Inna + sentence = sentence
Inna, rule 4
items: a) It is {{ruling|impermissible}} for it's خبر to precede it's إسم unless it's خبر {{condition|is a جار ومجرور or a ظرف}}. In which case, it is {{ruling|permissible but not necessary}}.
b) This rule is not limited to إنَّ, rather it applies to {{ruling|all of the الحروف المشبهة بالفعل}}.
c) Also, an appropriate auxiliary word will be employed.

blocks.ar:
إِنَّ فِي الدَّارِ زَيْدًا
الحرف المشبهة بالفعل: إنَّ
جملة إسمية: فِي الدَّارِ زَيْدٌ
جار ومجرور: فِي الدَّارِ
إنَّ + جملة = جملة
blocks.en: Indeed in the house is Zayd. Inna + sentence = sentence
Inna, rule 5
items: a) It is {{ruling|impermissible}} for it's خبر to precede it's إسم unless it's خبر {{condition|is a جار ومجرور or a ظرف}}. In which case, it is {{ruling|permissible but not necessary}}.
b) This rule is not limited to إنَّ, rather it applies to {{ruling|all of the الحروف المشبهة بالفعل}}.
c) Also, an appropriate auxiliary word will be employed.

blocks.ar:
إِنَّ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ أَعْمَالَنَا
الحرف المشبهة بالفعل: إنَّ
جملة إسمية: عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ أَعْمَالُنَا
ظرف: عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ
إنَّ + جملة = جملة
blocks.en: Indeed with Allah are our deeds. Inna + sentence = sentence
Inna, rule 6
items: a) Sometimes a "مَا" is attached to إنَّ.

b) This "مَا" is called "{{term|الكَافَّة}}" (The stopper) because it stops إنَّ from governing. It no longer makes the "مبتدا" منصوب and the "خبر" مرفوع. It absolutely cannot govern anymore. It is {{ruling|totally deactivated}}.
c) This rule applies to all. ({{condition|Except لَيْتَ}})
d) When this happens, إنَّ can enter {{ruling|both (جملة إسمية) & (جملة فعلية)}} sentences.

blocks.ar:
إِنَّمَا يَأْمُرُكُمْ بِالسُّوْءِ
الحرف المشبهة بالفعل: إنَّ
مَا الكَافَّةُ: مَا
إنَّ + مَا = لَا عَمَل
جملة فعلية: يَأْمُرُكُمْ بِالسُّوْءِ
إنَّمَا + جملة = جملة
blocks.en: He only commands you to evil. Inna + maa = no governing. Innamaa + sentence = sentence
Inna, rule 7
items: a) The "مَا الكَافَّة" not only stops the governing of إنَّ, but rather, it stops إنَّ from {{ruling|even having an إسم and a خبر}}.
b) The benefit of the "مَا الكَافَّة" is that, إنَّ, with the "مَا الكَافَّة" provide a meaning of ({{term|حصر}}) exclusivity i.e., together they translate as {{ruling|"only"}}.

blocks.ar:
إِنَّمَا اَللّٰهُ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ
الحرف المشبهة بالفعل: إنَّ
مَا الكَافَّةُ: مَا
إنَّ + مَا = لَا عَمَل
جملة إسمية: اللّٰهُ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ
إنَّمَا + جملة = جملة
blocks.en: Allah is only One God. Inna + maa = no governing. Innamaa + sentence = sentence
Inna, rule 8
items: a) Sometimes "لَ", a لام signifying {{ruling|emphasis}} is attached to the {{condition|خبر of إنَّ}}.

b) This "لَ" is called "{{term|المُزَحْلَقَة}}" (Moved over) because it was on the مبتدا before إنَّ entered upon it and was originally known as "{{term|لام الإبتِداء}}". However, it was moved over to the خبر of إنَّ {{condition|to avoid two consecutive words signifying emphasis}}.
c) The "لام المُزَحْلَقَة" is {{ruling|exclusive to إنَّ}}.

blocks.ar:
إِنَّ زَيدًا لَجَالِسٌ
الحرف المشبهة بالفعل: إنَّ
اللام المزحلقة: لَ
جملة إسمية: لَزَيْدٌ جَالِسٌ
إنَّ + جملة = جملة
blocks.en: Indeed Zayd is surely sitting. Inna + sentence = sentence
Inna, rule 9
items: a) The "لام المُزَحْلَقَة" can attach to a verb if a verb is the خبر of إنَّ provided the verb is {{condition|not preceded by a negation}} i.e., the verb must be {{ruling|مثبت}} and not منفي.
b) There are more conditions for this لام to attach to verbs correctly, one of which has been mentioned above. We will discuss them in the future Insha'Allah.

blocks.ar:
إِنَّ زَيدًا لَيَجْلِسُ
الحرف المشبهة بالفعل: إنَّ
اللام المزحلقة: لَ
جملة إسمية: لَزَيْدٌ يَجْلِسُ
إنَّ + جملة = جملة
blocks.en: Indeed Zayd surely sits. Inna + sentence = sentence
Inna, rule 10
items: a) The "لام المُزَحْلَقَة" can attach to the {{ruling|إسم of إنَّ}} if the {{condition|خبر of إنَّ precedes the إسم of إنَّ}} for the same reason of avoiding two consecutive words signifying emphasis.

blocks.ar:
إِنَّ فِي الدَّارِ لَزَيدًا
الحرف المشبهة بالفعل: إنَّ
اللام المزحلقة: لَ
جملة إسمية: لَزَيْدٌ فِي الدَّارِ
إنَّ + جملة = جملة
blocks.en: Indeed in the house is surely Zayd. Inna + sentence = sentence
Rules relating to "لام المُزَحْلَقَة" will be revisited in the future InshaAllah.
